# How the Six Life-Area Scores Are Built

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/how-life-areas-are-scored
Updated: 2026-10-15

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-10-11 Updated 2026-10-15
Each reading scores six life areas out of 100: love and attraction, relationship stability, career, wealth, learning and health. Every score starts at 50 and moves by a short list of named rules, each tied to one classical idea, so you can read exactly why a number is what it is. A second, separate figure, the percentile, says where that score stands among other charts. It does not replace the score and it is not a measure of strength.

## What are the six life areas?

Each area asks one question of the chart and reads a handful of Ten Gods (the ten roles that the other stems and branches play toward your Day Master), symbolic stars and palace checks. See the Ten Gods and Day Masters if these are new.

Area | The question | What it reads | 

Love and attraction | How much draw does the chart carry? | The spouse star's share, the romance star, expressive output | 

Relationship stability | How steady is the partnership palace? | The day branch, the spouse stars, the spouse element | 

Career | How well can the chart carry authority? | Authority stars, support from resource, whether the authority element is favourable | 

Wealth | How much can the chart earn and hold? | Wealth stars, the wealth vault, whether the wealth element is favourable | 

Learning | How well does the chart take in knowledge? | Resource, study stars, the link between authority and resource | 

Health | How firm is the constitution, as a tendency? | The Day Master's root, balance, the supply of the useful god | 

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How is a score built?

A score is 50 plus the sum of its chips, kept between 5 and 95. A chip is one rule with one signed number, and the full list is printed under every score in the reading. The word beside a score comes from where the score stands among 10,000 fictional reference charts, not from fixed cut-offs. In love, stability, career, wealth and health, the top quarter of charts read prominent, the middle half read balanced and the bottom quarter read needs support. Learning is the one exception and keeps the fixed cut-offs: 70 or more reads prominent, 45 to 69 reads balanced and under 45 reads needs support. The reason is that 37% of charts sit on learning's cap of 95, so a percentile word would call a learning score of 75 weak. The exception is to be revisited.

The thresholds in the chips (a star share of 15%, 20% and so on) and the sizes of the points are the engine's own calibration. What a star or a structure means is the classical part. The engine therefore labels the whole score a modern synthesis, and says so in the source line of every area.

Key facts

- Six areas, each 50 plus named chips, clamped to 5 to 95. Bands come from the percentile: the top 25% of reference charts read prominent, the middle 50% balanced, the bottom 25% needs support. Learning is the exception and keeps the fixed cut-offs: 70 and above prominent, 45 to 69 balanced, under 45 needs support.
- Health is read from the Day Master's root, balance and the supply of the useful god. The organ map is not scored; it stays in the advice text.
- The percentile is a second figure: where the score stands in a fixed reference sample of 10,000 fictional charts. It is a relative standing among charts, not strength.
- The reference is frozen as area_reference_v4. A change to any rule means a new version, never a silent regeneration.
- Classical books are cited at book level; a chapter is named only where it has been confirmed.

A worked example, using the fictional man 王大明 (born 1988-03-15, 09:30, weak Day Master). His learning score is 50, plus 10 for resource present, plus 10 for the canopy star, plus 5 for authority feeding resource, which makes 75: prominent. Every chip of that sum is listed in his reading.

How a life-area score is made: a classical score of 50 plus named chips, kept between 5 and 95, then a separate percentile placed in a frozen reference sample of 10,000 charts

## Which terms does this guide use?

The tables below use English names. Each Chinese term appears once, here, with its reading.

Term | Meaning | 

Day Master (日主) | The day stem, the "self" of the chart | 

useful god (用神) | The element the chart needs most | 

Ten Gods (十神) | The ten roles other stems play toward the Day Master | 

symbolic stars (神煞) | Named stars read from the pillars | 

authority (官殺), resource (印), wealth (財), output (食傷), peers (比劫) | The five Ten Gods groups | 

wealth vault (財庫) | A branch that stores wealth | 

rooting (通根) | The Day Master's element held in a branch's hidden stems | 

balance (中和) | Neither strong nor weak: the central classical health criterion | 

lopsided chart (偏枯) | One element dominates the chart | 

dominant chart (專旺) and follower chart (從格) | Charts that run with one overwhelming element | 

Six Clash (六沖) | Two opposite branches meeting | 

authority feeds resource (官印相生) | A classical structure for learning and office | 

wealth breaks resource (財壞印) | Wealth overruns a needed resource | 

peers rob wealth (比劫奪財) | Peers take the wealth star | 

mixed authority (官殺混雜) | Proper Officer and Seven Killings together | 

romance star (桃花), travel horse (驛馬), general star (將星), salary star (祿神), study star (文昌), canopy star (華蓋) | The symbolic stars used as chips | 

luck cycles (大運) and annual year (流年) | How the classics read illness through time | 

the three source books: Zi Ping Zhen Quan (子平真詮), Di Tian Sui (滴天髓), San Ming Tong Hui (三命通會) | Cited below by their pinyin | 

## Where does each chip come from?

The tables give each chip, its points, and the classical idea behind it. Books are cited by name only: Zi Ping Zhen Quan, Di Tian Sui and San Ming Tong Hui.

### Love and attraction

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Spouse star 20% or more of the chart | +15 | The wealth star for a man and the authority stars for a woman are the spouse stars. More of them means more in the chart to meet. | 

Spouse star 8% to under 20% | +5 | As above, present. | 

Spouse star faint (under 8%) or absent | -5 or -15 | A thin or missing spouse star is the traditional sign of a quiet or late partnership theme. | 

Romance star present | +15 | The peach-blossom star is the classical star of charm and attraction. | 

Output 10% or more | +5 | Output is how charm is shown. | 

Peers 30% or more, men only | -6 | Peers rob wealth: peers of your own element take the wealth star, which is a man's spouse star. It does not apply to a woman, whose spouse star is authority. | 

### Relationship stability

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Spouse palace clashed (day branch in a Six Clash) | -20 | A clash is the main classical flaw of the day branch. | 

Spouse palace in punishment or self-punishment, or in harm together with either | -5 | The classics rank clash above punishment above harm, so the lesser flaws cost less. | 

Spouse palace in harm on its own | -2 | Harm is the lightest of the three, and the engine weights it less than punishment. This weight is the engine's own choice, not a number from a text. | 

Spouse palace combined | +10 | A combination binds. A half harmony between the day branch and another branch counts only when it holds a cardinal branch (子, 午, 卯 or 酉); a half harmony without one, called 拱合, is listed but does not count. | 

Spouse palace undisturbed | +5 | A quiet palace. | 

Single clear spouse star, holding 8% or more of the chart | +10 | A pure spouse star is the classical ideal. A star under 8% is the faint star that the love score already marks down, so it does not also count as a clear anchor here. | 

Mixed spouse stars | -4 for a man, -8 for a woman | Mixed authority, Proper Officer and Seven Killings together in a woman's chart, is a named classical flaw. Mixed Direct and Indirect Wealth in a man's chart is the milder case. | 

No spouse star | -10 | Nothing anchors the partnership theme. | 

Spouse element is favourable or avoided | +10 or -10 | The useful-god test, applied to the element of the spouse star. | 

### Career

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Authority stars 15% or more, or under 5% | +15 or -5 | Authority is the star of position and responsibility. | 

Power element favourable or avoided | +10 or -10 | The useful-god test, applied to the authority element. | 

Resource cushions pressure: resource 10% or more with authority at 15% or more | +10 | Resource turns authority into support, in the Seven Killings and Proper Officer forms alike. Without authority there is nothing to cushion, so the chip needs it. | 

No resource under authority: resource under 5% with authority at 15% or more | -4 | The same structure, absent. It never fires when authority is also absent. | 

Travel horse star, general star | +5, +10 | Stars rank below structure in the classics: they add to a chart, they do not decide it. | 

The strong or weak Day Master verdict is not a separate chip here. It already decides which elements are favourable, and the power-element chip above carries it, so counting it again would score the same fact twice.

### Wealth

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Wealth stars 15% or more, 8% to under 15%, faint, absent | +15, +5, -5, -15 | The wealth stars are wealth. | 

Wealth element favourable or avoided | +10 or -10 | The useful-god test. | 

Wealth vault branch in the chart | +10 | The vault holds wealth. | 

Salary star | +5 | The star of earned income. | 

The strong or weak Day Master verdict is not a separate chip here either. It already decides which elements are favourable, and the wealth-element chip above carries it, so counting it again would score the same fact twice.

### Learning

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Resource 15% or more, or 8% to under 15% | +20 or +10 | Resource is the star of learning. | 

Study star or study hall | +15 | Classical study stars. | 

Canopy star | +10 | The star of study and solitude. | 

Output 10% or more | +5 | Output shows what was learned. | 

Authority feeds resource: authority 15% or more and resource 8% or more | +5 | A classical learned structure (Zi Ping Zhen Quan, on the seal and the proper officer). | 

Thin resource (under 8%) for a weak Day Master | 0 to -6, graded | A weak Day Master needs resource. The penalty grows smoothly as the share falls and never exceeds 6. A strong Day Master is not penalised for thin resource. | 

Wealth breaks resource: wealth 30% or more, resource under 15%, resource favourable, peers under 15% | -6 | Wealth breaks a wanted resource when nothing shields it (Zi Ping Zhen Quan, on the seal). | 

### Health

Chip | Points | Classical basis | 

Day Master rooted, or rootless | +8 or -5 | A Day Master with a root in a branch stands on firm ground (Di Tian Sui). | 

Strength near balance: strength score within 1.0 of zero | +8 | Balance is the central classical health criterion (Di Tian Sui). | 

Useful elements hold 55% or more of the chart, or 35% or less | +6 or -5 | Whether the useful god has force. | 

One element holds 45% or more | -5 | Lopsided charts are classically fragile, except as below. | 

The last chip does not apply to a dominant or follower chart that runs with its useful god. These are sound structures, so they are exempt.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## Why is health read from the Day Master and not from an organ map?

An older version of the health score counted organ-map flags: eight points off for each element at 30% or more, or at 7% or less, of the chart. We removed that from the score for three reasons.

- The classics pair elements with organs, but they give no percentage cut. The 30% and 7% lines were the engine's, resting on its own hidden-stem weights. A 7% share is less than the weight of one stem, so a flag could appear or vanish on a single stem.

- The classics read illness where the useful god or the Day Master is damaged, not wherever shares are lopsided. A useful element in excess is not an affliction, and a harmful element that is missing is not one either.

- The classics read illness mostly through the luck cycles and the year. A natal score can only describe a tendency, which is why it is labelled constitution.

So health now reads three things the classics do read: the root of the Day Master, balance, and the supply of the useful god. The organ-map flags stay in the reading's advice text as a watch list of elements and the body systems that tradition pairs with them. They are reference for reflection, not medical advice, and they no longer move a number. The "For Me" health card follows the same rule, so the card and the reading agree.

## What is the percentile, and what is it not?

The raw scores sit on different scales. A typical learning score is 90 and a typical stability score is 46, so a 60 means something different in each. Before the band words followed the percentile, "prominent" was easy to earn in learning and hard to earn in stability. Each score is therefore placed in a frozen reference sample of fictional charts, and the band word in five of the six areas, and the comparison between areas, read that standing. Learning is the exception: so many charts sit on its cap that its word keeps the fixed cut-offs.

The percentile is the share of reference charts that score below the number, with half of those that tie counted, as a whole number from 0 to 100. A learning score of 75 reads prominent under the fixed cut-offs, yet its percentile is 19, because most reference charts score higher in learning; the percentile is shown beside it and does not change its word. 王大明's health score of 67 reads prominent, with a percentile of 90.

The percentile is a relative standing among charts, not strength. It does not make the score more or less true, and the number never changes. In every area except learning it also decides the band word: a percentile of 75 or more reads prominent and 25 or less reads needs support. It is used where areas are compared with each other: the strongest and weakest area on your card and in the story, the priority line, and the lowest-area sentence for children. Every sentence that states a score still states the score.

## What is in the reference sample?

The sample is 10,000 fictional charts, drawn with a fixed random seed (20261061). Birth dates are uniform across the days from 1930-01-01 to 2024-12-31, with a uniform minute of the day and an even split of sexes. It is version area_reference_v4, built against engine version life-areas-v5, and stored as a histogram of scores per area. It replaced version 3 (seed 20261044, built against life-areas-v4) on 2026-10-15, when the year and month pillars began to change at the exact moment of each solar term (節). Version 3 had replaced version 2 (seed 20261043, built against life-areas-v3) the same day, when the duplicate strong-or-weak chips left career and wealth. Versions 1 to 3 are kept, unedited, as the record of what the percentile used to be measured against. Nobody's real birth data is in any of them.

Area | Median score | Middle half of charts | Prominent | Needs support | 

Love and attraction | 69 | 60 to 75 | 27% | 20% | 

Relationship stability | 46 | 34 to 60 | 26% | 25% | 

Career | 70 | 61 to 80 | 24% | 24% | 

Wealth | 60 | 55 to 70 | 24% | 19% | 

Learning (fixed cut-offs) | 90 | 80 to 95 | 89% | 0% | 

Health | 58 | 53 to 64 | 19% | 30% | 

The shares are not exactly 25, 50 and 25 because scores are whole numbers and many charts share the same one. Learning is shown by its fixed cut-offs, because 37% of charts sit on the cap of 95.

The file is never regenerated silently. A test pins its checksum, and a second test checks that today's engine still reproduces a probe of 12 charts stored in the file. If a rule is ever changed, the right step is a new version beside the old one, so a percentile always names the sample it was measured against. That has now happened three times, as described above.

## FAQ

### How is each life-area score calculated?

Each score starts at 50 and adds the chips listed under it in your reading, then is kept between 5 and 95. Each chip is one rule with one signed number, tied to a classical idea such as the spouse star, authority feeding resource, or the Day Master's root.

### Why is my health score not based on organs?

Because the classics give no percentage cut for an organ flag, and they read illness through the Day Master and the useful god. The score reads the Day Master's root, balance and the supply of the useful god. The organ-map flags remain in the advice text but no longer move the score.

### What does the percentile beside my score mean?

It is where your score stands among a fixed sample of 10,000 fictional charts, from 0 to 100. It is a relative standing among charts, not strength. In every area except learning the band word follows the percentile, so a prominent score always stands in the top quarter of charts. Learning keeps the fixed cut-offs, so a prominent learning score can have a low percentile.

### Why is my strongest area not my highest score?

Because the strongest area on your card is picked by percentile, not by the raw number. Learning scores run high for most charts, so a learning 75 can stand lower among charts than a health 67.

### Will the percentile change if the engine changes?

Not silently. The reference is frozen as area_reference_v4. If a rule changes, a new version is built next to it and the percentile names the version it used.

## Sources and method

- Ten Gods, stars and palaces: the classical Zi Ping structure readings, cited at book level in Zi Ping Zhen Quan, Di Tian Sui and San Ming Tong Hui.

- Thresholds and point sizes: the engine's own calibration, labelled a modern synthesis. They are not classical numbers.

- Health: the Day Master's root, balance and the supply of the useful god, as a static natal tendency. The organ map is reference and not medical advice.

- Percentile: the mid-rank share inside area_reference_v4, built by scripts/build_area_reference.py with seed 20261061.

See the scores applied to a chart in the free reading, and the ten claims the engine commits to on the method page.

# Is BaZi Deterministic? Computed, Not Chatted

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/is-bazi-deterministic
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-09
BaZi is deterministic in its calculation and rule-guided in its interpretation. The pillars, strength score, favourable elements, ten gods and luck cycles all follow written rules. The same birth data therefore gives the same result every time.

## Which parts of a BaZi reading are deterministic?

Most of the structure is arithmetic on a calendar. Each step has one correct answer under a stated convention, and two honest implementations should agree to the digit. Table 1 follows the sample chart through each step. The sample is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore.

Key facts

- The same birth data or floor plan always gives the same result, which is claim one of the ten method claims at /method.
- Every output line names the classical rule it applies, with a rule id a practitioner can check.
- The sample's clock time 09:30 becomes true solar time 08:16, using longitude 103.8517°E and an equation of time of -9.4 minutes.
- The strength rule has four steps and returns weak Day Master (身弱) with a score of -0.97, from support 6.33 against drain 3.67.
- The sample's luck cycles run forward from the month pillar 乙卯 (Wood Rabbit) and start at age 6.8.
- No generative AI writes any reading, and the engine does not predict events.

Pipeline from birth data through true solar time, four pillars, strength, favourable elements and luck cycles to a reading in which each line cites its rule
Table 1: the sample chart, step by step

Step | Rule | Sample result | 

True solar time | clock converted by longitude and equation of time | 09:30 becomes 08:16 | 

Four pillars | solar terms, Start of Spring (立春) year boundary, sixty-day cycle | 戊辰 (Earth Dragon) 乙卯 己巳 (Earth Snake) 戊辰 | 

Strength | season, support, drain, root | Weak Day Master, score -0.97 | 

Favourable elements | Support-and-restrain method (扶抑法) then climate-adjustment method (調候法) | Fire (火) and Earth (土) | 

Ten gods | each stem's relation to the Day Master | Rob Wealth (劫財) 48.1 %, Seven Killings (七殺) 29.6 % | 

Luck cycles | Yang men and yin women count forward (陽男陰女順行), luck-cycle start (起運) = days to the solar-term boundary (距節日數) / 3 | forward from 乙卯, start age 6.8 | 

The useful god (用神) step uses the four classical methods (support-and-restrain method, climate-adjustment method, bridging element (通關), illness and remedy (病藥)) in a defined order. For the sample, the first two produced Fire and Earth as favourable and Wood (木), Water (水) and Metal (金) as unfavourable. A different order would be a different system, which is why the order is written down.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How does the strength rule show the idea?

The strength rule is a good test case, because it looks like judgement and is actually four fixed steps. For the sample Day Master 己 (Earth), the engine does the following.

- Season. The month branch 卯 (Rabbit, Wood) is Wood, and Wood controls Earth, so the season state is dead (死), scoring -2.0.

- Support. Peers (Earth 5.33) plus resource (Fire 1.0) give 6.33.

- Drain. Output, wealth and authority combined give 3.67.

- Root. The branches 辰 (Dragon, Earth), 巳 (Snake, Fire) and 辰 hold Earth in their hidden stems, so the Day Master is rooted.

The result is weak Day Master, with a score of -0.97 in an ordinary structure. Anyone can check the arithmetic by hand, which is the point. The engine prints each step with its rule id: the sample's citations list time-policy, strength-4step and dayun-direction, each tied to a named convention.

## Which parts are interpretation?

What a weak Earth Day Master with heavy authority stars means for a career is interpretation. It is still not freeform. The engine holds fixed sentence patterns for each palace and god, and fills them from the computed chart. The month palace template, for example, reads the career headquarters through the month stem's god. For the sample, that god is Seven Killings, which the engine words as raw pressure and discipline imposed from outside.

So the interpretive layer is written by people, in advance, and applied by rule. A sentence in a reading can be traced to a pattern, and the pattern can be argued with. That is a different thing from text produced fresh each time.

Some parts are weaker still, and the engine says so. The life-domain scores, such as learning at 70 and constitution at 26, are labelled a modern synthesis of star shares, symbolic stars and palace checks. They are rule-derived, but they are not classical doctrine (method note).

## Where do schools disagree?

The engine records its choices where traditions differ and marks the choice as disputed. The strength step shows one. The engine reads the month by the branch's own element. The seasonal strength (旺相休囚死) school reads it by the season's element, and the two can differ near a season change. The engine's step text names the alternative and gives an example, so the disagreement is visible in the output.

Strokes for naming follow the Kangxi Dictionary (康熙字典) count on the traditional form. The 81-number verdicts use a two-state scale until a finer cited table is adopted. Those are stated choices, not hidden ones.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## Why does determinism matter when choosing a tool?

A tool that generates fluent text without rules fails in three ways that a rule engine does not. These are logical points about the method, not tests of any named product (method note).

- Calendar edge cases. The Start of Spring boundary, true solar time and the pre-1982 Singapore clock each change a pillar. A rule engine applies them in the same order every time.

- No traceable rule. A sentence produced by pattern completion has no rule id, because no rule produced it. You cannot check it.

- Repeatability. Text generated fresh can differ on each ask. A calculation cannot, so it can be tested.

Fluency is not method. The site's method claims put it plainly: no generative AI writes any reading, and the text is rule output plus hand-written guides.

## Is deterministic the same as fatalistic?

No. The word describes the computation, not your life. The engine states that it does not predict events. It computes classical structures and states their traditional reading. A chart is a starting condition and a map of tendencies, and the readings are framed that way.

The reason to want an exact chart is practical. The actionable layers, such as colours, directions, dates and room choices, then rest on a correct starting point. A wrong hour pillar propagates into every later layer. The ten gods guide shows what a later layer does with the pillars it is given.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

Local time rules are where determinism is tested hardest.

- Year boundary. The BaZi year turns at Start of Spring, which falls on 2027-02-04 in 2027. A late-January birth belongs to the earlier year. The engine gives year pillar 丙午 (Fire Horse) for 2027-01-20 and 丁未 (Fire Goat) for 2027-02-10.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. The method page states that clock times before 1982 use the offset of that era.

- True solar time. The conversion uses longitude and the equation of time, so a Singapore birth at 09:30 is cast as 08:16.

- Homes. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, the direction and date layers take your door bearing as input. The same bearing gives the same output, which makes the result easy to check against a second tool.

## FAQ

### Is BaZi deterministic?

BaZi is deterministic in its calculation and rule-guided in its interpretation. The pillars, strength score, favourable elements, ten gods and luck cycles all follow written rules. The same birth data therefore gives the same result every time.

### Does deterministic mean my fate is fixed?

No. The word describes the computation, not your life. The engine states that it does not predict events. A chart is a starting condition and a map of tendencies, and the readings are framed that way.

### Which parts of a BaZi reading are interpretation?

The meaning of a chart, such as what a weak Day Master with heavy authority stars means for a career, is interpretation. It is not freeform. The engine holds fixed sentence patterns for each palace and god, written by people in advance.

### Does an AI write my BaZi reading?

No generative AI writes any reading. The text is rule output plus hand-written guides. Every output line names the classical rule it applies, with a rule id a practitioner can check.

### Why might my chart differ between tools in Singapore or Malaysia?

Local time rules are where determinism is tested hardest. The BaZi year turns at Start of Spring, Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01, and true solar time shifts the clock. A tool that skips these will cast different pillars.

## Sources and method

- Method claims: the ten claims at /method, including determinism, rule ids per line, true solar time and no generative AI (method note).

- Strength rule: seasonal strength with rooting (通根), in four steps.

- Favourable elements: the four useful god methods, support-and-restrain method, climate-adjustment method, bridging element and illness and remedy.

- Luck cycles: yang men and yin women count forward, yin men and yang women count backward (陰男陽女逆行), with luck-cycle start = days to the solar-term boundary / 3.

- Time convention: the 子平 (classical BaZi school) convention of true solar time.

- Stroke counts: Kangxi Dictionary.

- Interpretive text: fixed sentence patterns written in advance (method note).

Get a reading whose lines each cite a rule at /start, and see how the favourable elements are chosen in useful god colours.

# Luck Cycles (大運) and Annual Windows

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/luck-cycles-and-windows
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-09
A birth chart is fixed, and BaZi models time with two moving layers on top of it. The luck cycles are ten-year pillars derived from the month pillar, and the annual pillar (annual year, 流年) changes every Start of Spring (立春). The decade is the climate, and the year is the weather inside it.

## How are luck cycles worked out?

A luck cycle is a stem and branch pair that overlays the natal chart for ten years. The sequence starts from the month pillar and steps through the sixty-pair cycle. Two rules fix the direction and the start age.

The direction is yang men and yin women count forward (陽男陰女順行), yin men and yang women count backward (陰男陽女逆行). A yang-year man or a yin-year woman runs forward. A yin-year man or a yang-year woman runs backward. The start age is luck-cycle start (起運) = days to the solar-term boundary (距節日數) / 3, which means the days from birth to the nearest solar-term boundary (節), divided by three.

The sample is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His pillars are 戊辰 (Earth Dragon) 乙卯 (Wood Rabbit) 己巳 (Earth Snake) 戊辰, and his Day Master is 己 (yin Earth). His year stem 戊 (yang Earth) is yang, so he runs forward from the month pillar 乙卯. The count goes to the solar-term boundary of Clear and Bright (清明), and the start age comes out at 6.8.

Key facts

- Luck cycles step from the month pillar, forward or backward by the rule yang men and yin women count forward, yin men and yang women count backward.
- The start age is luck-cycle start = days to the solar-term boundary / 3, and the sample's is 6.8 (counted to the solar-term boundary Clear and Bright).
- The sample's current decade is 己未 (Earth Goat), ages 37-47, graded growth with a score of +2.
- The weakest decade ahead is 辛酉 (Metal Rooster), ages 57-67, graded corrective at -3, with a clash on the month branch 卯 (Rabbit, Wood).
- The 2027 year pillar 丁未 (Fire Goat) starts at Start of Spring on 2027-02-04, with career and health cautions and a study window.
- The year 2030 (庚戌, Metal Dog) clashes open the sample's sealed wealth vault 辰 (Dragon, Earth).

Timeline of the sample's eight luck cycles from age 7 to 87, each graded growth, consolidation or corrective, with the current decade marked
See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How is a decade graded?

Each decade's stem and branch are read against the chart's favourable and unfavourable elements. For the sample, the favourable elements are Fire (火) and Earth (土), and the unfavourable are Wood (木), Water (水) and Metal (金). The engine also checks combinations and clashes between the decade branch and the natal pillars. The result is a phase label and a score.

Table 1: the sample's eight luck cycles

Pillar | Ages | Phase | Score | Why | 

丙辰 (Fire Dragon) | 7-17 | growth (成長) | +2 | stem 丙 (yang Fire) Fire and branch 辰 Earth favourable | 

丁巳 (Fire Snake) | 17-27 | growth | +2 | stem 丁 (yin Fire) Fire and branch 巳 (Snake, Fire) Fire favourable | 

戊午 (Earth Horse) | 27-37 | growth | +2 | stem 戊 Earth and branch 午 (Horse, Fire) Fire favourable | 

己未 | 37-47 | growth | +2 | stem 己 Earth and branch 未 (Goat, Earth) Earth favourable (current) | 

庚申 (Metal Monkey) | 47-57 | consolidation build-up (蓄勢) | -1 | both unfavourable, but Six Harmony (六合) with a core pillar steadies it | 

辛酉 | 57-67 | corrective consolidation (修整) | -3 | both unfavourable, and 酉 (Rooster, Metal) clashes month branch 卯 | 

壬戌 (Water Dog) | 67-77 | consolidation build-up | +1 | stem 壬 (yang Water) unfavourable, branch 戌 (Dog, Earth) favourable, Six Harmony steadies it | 

癸亥 (Water Pig) | 77-87 | corrective consolidation | -3 | both unfavourable, and 亥 (Pig, Water) clashes day branch 巳 | 

The labels and scores are the engine's own (method note). Two habits keep the reading honest. First, a corrective decade is not a bad life. It is a season with different work, such as maintenance, learning and pruning. Second, each decade brings its own gods. The sample's 庚申 decade brings Hurting Officer (傷官) on both stem and branch, a god that is nearly absent in his natal chart. The ten gods guide lists all eight pillars with their gods.

## How are annual windows read?

Within a decade, each year is checked per life area, not given one verdict. The engine looks at career, wealth, relationship, health, study and movement. Each area shows one of three flags: a window, a caution, or quiet.

A window is a tailwind and a caution is a navigation note. Neither is a prediction. The flags come from fixed rules, such as the year branch combining with or clashing a natal pillar. Table 2 shows the sample's years from 2027 to 2030.

Table 2: selected annual flags for the sample

Year | Pillar | Flags raised | 

2027 | 丁未 | career caution (combines into Wood (合化木) feeds an unfavourable element); health caution (year feeds Earth excess); study window (Indirect Resource (偏印) arrives) | 

2028 | 戊申 (Earth Monkey) | relationship caution (combines into Water (合化水) is unfavourable); health caution; study window; movement window (combination (合) day branch) | 

2029 | 己酉 (Earth Rooster) | career caution (酉 clashes month 卯); relationship window (桃花 (romance star) year); study caution; health caution | 

2030 | 庚戌 | career window (combination month pillar); wealth window (沖開財庫 辰); study window; movement caution (clashes year branch 辰) | 

Read across a row, a year is mixed. 2030 offers a wealth window and a movement caution in the same twelve months. That is normal. The engine reports each area separately so you can plan around it.

## What are the vault, the peach blossom and other timed stars?

Some chart features exist only as timing. The wealth vault (財庫) is the storage branch of your wealth element. The sample's wealth element is Water, and its vault is 辰, which is present in his chart but sealed. A vault opens in the year whose branch clashes it. For 辰 that is any 戌 year, so 庚戌 in 2030 is flagged as a classical accumulation year.

The peach blossom (桃花) branch governs attraction years. For the sample, whose year branch 辰 sits in the 申 (Monkey, Metal)·子 (Rat, Water)·辰 group, the peach blossom branch is 酉. The 2029 year 己酉 therefore carries the relationship window. The symbolic stars guide lists the lookup tables behind these stars.

This is why two people with similar charts diverge. Their calendars strike different pillars at different ages.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How do you use the timeline in practice?

Read the decade band first, to see where you are in the arc. Then read the current year's flags, area by area. Then plan against the next window. A short sequence works for most people.

- Find the current decade and its phase. For the sample in 2026, at age 38, it is 己未, growth.

- Check the year pillar for the year you are planning. For 2027 it is 丁未.

- Look only at the area you care about, such as career or study.

- Treat a caution as a reason to pace the decision, not to cancel it.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

The luck sequence depends on exact birth data, so local time rules matter.

- Year boundary. The annual pillar changes at Start of Spring, not on 1 January. Start of Spring falls on 2026-02-04, 2027-02-04 and 2028-02-04. A birth in late January or early February may belong to the earlier year. That changes the year stem, its polarity and the direction of the luck cycles.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A wrong offset can move the birth across a solar-term boundary, which changes the start age.

- Start age. The start age depends on the distance to the solar-term boundary, so a birth close to a boundary can shift it by months.

- Moves. The movement flag is one input if you are changing homes. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, the move-in day itself is chosen by a separate filter, described in move-in date selection.

## FAQ

### What is a BaZi luck cycle (luck cycles)?

A luck cycle is a ten-year stem and branch pillar that overlays your natal chart. It is derived from the month pillar. The decade is the climate, and the annual pillar, which changes every Start of Spring, is the weather inside it.

### How is the age my luck cycle starts calculated?

The start age is the days from birth to the nearest solar-term boundary, a solar-term boundary, divided by three. The direction is forward for a yang-year man or a yin-year woman, and backward otherwise. The sample's start age is 6.8.

### Does a corrective decade mean a bad life?

No. A corrective decade is a season with different work, such as maintenance, learning and pruning. The labels and scores are the engine's own. A caution is a reason to pace a decision, not to cancel it.

### How are annual windows and cautions read?

Each year is checked per life area: career, wealth, relationship, health, study and movement. Each area shows a window, a caution or quiet. A window is a tailwind and a caution is a navigation note. Neither is a prediction.

### Why does my birth time zone change my luck cycles in Singapore or Malaysia?

Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. A wrong offset can move a birth across a solar-term boundary, which changes the start age. The year also turns at Start of Spring, which can change the direction of the cycles.

## Sources and method

- Luck sequence: yang men and yin women count forward, yin men and yang women count backward, starting from the month pillar.

- Start age: luck-cycle start = days to the solar-term boundary / 3.

- Decade grading: favourable and unfavourable elements from the useful god (用神) method, plus branch combinations and clashes (method note).

- Annual flags: fixed rules on the year branch against the natal pillars (method note).

- Branch relations: Six Harmony and Six Clash (六沖) tables as in 三命通會 (Ming-era BaZi classic), in the chapters the engine cites.

- Wealth vault: the storage branch of the wealth element, opened by its clash.

See your own decade band in the free reading at /start, and compare the timeline with the stars that mark it in symbolic stars.

# Move-In Date (入宅) Selection: Day Officers

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/move-in-date-selection
Updated: 2026-10-08

Dates

By BaziMaster 2026-09-16 Updated 2026-10-08
Move-in date selection (入宅擇日) is a filter over the calendar. It keeps days whose day officer (建除) is Completion (成), Settle (定) or Open (開), then removes days whose branch clashes with the occupants or the house. Because the filters are fixed rules, a computer can run them exactly and a careful almanac reader gets the same days.

## How does the day-officer rule work?

Every day carries one of twelve officers (twelve day officers, 建除十二神). The officer is the offset of the day's branch from the month's branch: the day whose branch equals the month branch is Establish (建), the next branch is Remove (除), and so on round the cycle of twelve. This is the twelve day officers (十二建除) rule of the 協紀辨方書 (Qing almanac manual) tradition.

For moving in, the engine keeps three officers: Completion, Settle and Open. Everything else is passed over. A day whose branch clashes the month branch is a Month Breaker (月破) day, the hard avoid.

Key facts

- The 12 day officers run from Establish to Close (閉), and the engine keeps 3 of them for move-in: Completion, Settle and Open.
- Officer = (day branch minus month branch) modulo 12, counted from Establish.
- A move-in day is also dropped if its branch clashes an occupant's year branch, clashes the sitting branch or equals the year's Grand Duke (太歲) branch.
- In 2027 the Grand Duke branch is 未 (SW1, 202.5-217.5 degrees) and the year starts at Start of Spring (立春), 2027-02-04.
- For the sample household, facing 14.0 degrees, the engine returns 9 auspicious days between 2027-03-01 and 2027-04-30.
- The first of those is 2027-03-04, a 壬午 (Water Horse) day with officer Settle.

Flow chart of move-in date selection: twelve day officers, keep Completion Settle Open, remove branch clashes, then choose an entry hour
Get move-in dates for your own household: free home tool →

## What are the twelve officers worth?

The engine's date selection (擇日) layer rates each officer with a score (method note: these are the engine's weights, not a classical table). The move-in filter itself is simpler: it keeps Completion, Settle and Open and orders them Completion first, then Settle, then Open.

Cycle position | Officer | Engine score | Move-in use | 

0 | Establish | +0.5 | passed over | 

1 | Remove | +0.5 | passed over | 

2 | Full (滿) | +0.5 | passed over | 

3 | Neutral (平) | -0.5 | passed over | 

4 | Settle | +1.0 | kept for move-in | 

5 | Hold (執) | +0.0 | passed over | 

6 | Destruction | -2.0 | passed over | 

7 | Danger (危) | -1.0 | passed over | 

8 | Completion | +2.0 | kept for move-in | 

9 | Receive (收) | +0.0 | passed over | 

10 | Open | +1.5 | kept for move-in | 

11 | Close | -1.0 | passed over | 

Cycle position 0 is the day whose branch equals the month branch. The scores are used when a day is rated for a household, where destruction at -2.0 is the worst and Completion at +2.0 the best.

## Which days are struck out by clashes?

Each branch clashes with the one opposite it: 子 (Rat, Water) and 午 (Horse, Fire), 丑 (Ox, Earth) and 未, 寅 (Tiger, Wood) and 申 (Monkey, Metal), 卯 (Rabbit, Wood) and 酉 (Rooster, Metal), 辰 (Dragon, Earth) and 戌 (Dog, Earth), 巳 (Snake, Fire) and 亥 (Pig, Water). After the officer filter the engine drops a day when its branch:

- Clashes any occupant's year branch (Six Clash, 六沖), so the move does not collide with anyone who will live there.

- Clashes the sitting branch (clashes the sitting, 沖坐山), the branch of the direction the house sits toward, derived from the facing bearing.

- Equals the year's Grand Duke branch (meets the Grand Duke, 值太歲). In 2027 that branch is 未.

The engine can also rate a day for each household member, using a clash with their year branch (clashes the zodiac animal, 沖生肖), a clash with their day-pillar branch, and a Six Harmony (六合) bonus. Those are softer, personal layers on top of the move-in filter.

Last, the engine can return entry hours for a chosen day, computed from the day branch, the occupants' branches and the facing.

Get move-in dates for your own household: free home tool →

## What does a worked example look like?

The sample inputs are the occupant branches 辰 and 巳 (the sample person's year and day branches, passed to the engine as a two-branch household). The facing is 14.0 degrees, and the window is 2027-03-01 to 2027-04-30. A 辰 occupant removes 戌 days and a 巳 occupant removes 亥 days, and 未 days are removed as Grand Duke.

The engine returns 9 days. The first four listed are:

Date | Weekday | Day pillar | Officer | 

2027-03-04 | Thu | 壬午 | Settle | 

2027-04-11 | Sun | 庚申 (Metal Monkey) | Settle | 

2027-04-23 | Fri | 壬申 (Water Monkey) | Settle | 

2027-03-11 | Thu | 己丑 (Earth Ox) | Open | 

You can check the officers by hand with the offset rule. On 2027-03-11 the month branch is 卯 and the day branch is 丑, which sits 10 places on from 卯 in the cycle of twelve, and position 10 is Open. On 2027-04-11 the month branch is 辰 and the day branch is 申, 4 places on, which is Settle. Other days in the engine's output show why most are passed over: 2027-03-06 (甲申, Wood Monkey) is Hold, 2027-03-15 (癸巳, Water Snake) is Full and 2027-04-08 (丁巳, Fire Snake) is Remove.

Nine days out of a 61-day window is a short list, which is why the window should be generous. The filter knows nothing about your leave days, lift bookings or key-collection date, so choose the window first, take the engine's list, then fit practical constraints to it. If none of the nine works, widen the window rather than relaxing a clash rule.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia homes?

- Facing. For an HDB flat or condominium unit, take the facing from the unit's main door, outward, as a bearing in degrees. The sitting branch follows from it, so a different bearing can change which days survive.

- Year boundary. The 2027 year begins at Start of Spring on 2027-02-04. The positions below apply to the 丁未 (Fire Goat) year that opens on that date.

- 2027 year positions. Grand Duke is at 未, SW1. Year Breaker (歲破) is at 丑, NE1, 22.5-37.5 degrees. Three Killings (三煞) covers the west, 232.5-307.5 degrees. A door facing 14.0 degrees lies outside all three bands. These are rule-derived positions from the year spirits (年神) rules of the 協紀辨方書.

- Time. Dates here follow the calendar as set by the solar terms, which the engine takes from an astronomical library. Singapore and Malaysia both use UTC+8 today.

## FAQ

### How is a move-in date chosen in feng shui?

Move-in date selection is a filter over the calendar. It keeps days whose day officers officer is Completion, Settle or Open. It then removes days whose branch clashes with the occupants or the house. Fixed rules mean a careful almanac reader gets the same days.

### What are the twelve day officers?

Every day carries one of twelve officers (twelve day officers), set by the day branch's offset from the month branch. The day whose branch equals the month branch is Establish, and the next is Remove. For moving in, only Completion, Settle and Open are kept.

### Which days are struck out for a house move?

After the officer filter, a day is dropped if its branch clashes an occupant's year branch or the sitting branch. A day is also dropped if it equals the year's Grand Duke branch. In 2027 the Grand Duke branch is 未. A day that clashes the month branch is destruction, the hard avoid.

### What do I need to give for a move-in date in Singapore or Malaysia?

You need the occupants' year branches, the facing bearing in degrees and a date window. For an HDB flat or condo, take the facing from the unit's main door, outward. A different bearing can change which days survive.

### What if none of the suggested days works for my schedule?

The filter knows nothing about your leave days, lift bookings or key collection date. Choose the window first, take the list, then fit practical constraints to it. If none works, widen the window rather than relaxing a clash rule.

## Sources and method

- Day officers: the twelve day officers rule, with the officer set by the day branch's offset from the month branch.

- Kept officers: Completion, Settle and Open for move-in, the engine's convention (method note).

- Month breaker: Month Breaker, the day whose branch clashes the month branch, treated as a hard avoid.

- Clash filters: the Six Clash pairs applied to occupants' year branches, the sitting branch and the Grand Duke branch.

- 2027 positions: the year spirits position rules of 協紀辨方書, applied to the 丁未 year.

- Scope: the engine does not run the full almanac layers (twenty-eight mansions, individual stars), so its verdict may differ from a printed almanac (method note).

Run the same filter for your own household with the free home tool at /fengshui, which reads every occupant's year branch and your facing.

# Naming a baby born in 2027

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/naming-a-baby-born-in-2027
Updated: 2026-10-15

Naming

By BaziMaster 2026-10-15 Updated 2026-10-15
A baby born in 2027 needs a name that suits the baby's own chart, not the year. The Fire Goat year (丁未) fixes only one of the four pillars. The birth month, day and hour change which element the baby needs, and across 17,530 charts the engine cast for the year, Water (水) is needed most often.

Key facts

- The 2027 Fire Goat year starts at Start of Spring (立春), 09:45:59 on 4 February 2027 by the Singapore clock, and runs to the next one at 15:30:53 on 4 February 2028.
- A baby born from 1 January 2027 until Start of Spring belongs to the Fire Horse year (丙午).
- In 17,530 engine-cast charts for the Goat year, Water (水) is favourable in 62.6%, Wood (木) in 53.4%, Fire (火) in 51.5%, Metal (金) in 48.8% and Earth (土) in 39.2%.
- Water is favourable in 99.0% of summer charts and Fire in 96.6% of winter charts.
- The name builder changes the year and every month at the exact moment of the solar term, so a baby born at 05:00 on 4 February 2027 is still a Fire Horse baby and one born at 11:00 is a Goat baby.

## When does the 2027 baby year start?

The Fire Goat year starts at Start of Spring, at 09:45:59 on 4 February 2027 on the Singapore clock (UTC+8). A baby born earlier in January 2027, or at 05:00 that morning, is still a Fire Horse baby, and a baby born from 1 January 2028 up to 15:30:53 on 4 February 2028 is a Goat baby. The 2027 baby elements table lists all twelve month changes.

Score a name for your own baby: free name builder →

## What does the Goat year change in a baby's chart?

It changes one pillar: every baby born in the year has the Year Pillar 丁未, a Fire stem on an Earth branch. The Month, Day and Hour Pillars come from the birth date and time. They set the Day Master (日主), its strength and the elements the baby needs, so two babies born a few months apart can need opposite elements.

The engine finds those elements in two steps. Support and restrain (扶抑) judges whether the Day Master is strong or weak and lists the elements that balance it. Climate adjustment (調候) can then add Fire for a winter month or Water for a summer month. What a useful god (用神) is explains both.

## Which elements do 2027 babies most often need?

Water is needed most often: it is favourable in 62.6% of the charts and is the lead useful god in 29.1%. The lead useful god is the first element on a chart's favourable list. Wood is favourable in 53.4%, Fire in 51.5%, Metal in 48.8% and Earth in 39.2%.

The pattern follows the season of birth:

Bar chart of the element that 2027 babies most often need in each birth season, from the engine's 17,530 charts: Water (水) in 99.0% of summer charts, Fire (火) in 96.6% of winter charts, Wood (木) in 82.1% of autumn charts, Metal (金) in 67.2% of spring charts. Source: the 2027 baby elements table at /data/2027-baby-elements.
Season of birth | Born between | Favourable most often | Share of charts, % | 

Spring | 4 Feb 2027 and 5 May 2027 | Metal (金) | 67.2 | 

Summer | 6 May 2027 and 7 Aug 2027 | Water (水) | 99.0 | 

Autumn | 8 Aug 2027 and 7 Nov 2027 | Wood (木) | 82.1 | 

Winter | 7 Nov 2027 and 4 Feb 2028 | Fire (火) | 96.6 | 

Summer babies almost always carry Water because the climate rule adds it, and winter babies carry Fire for the same reason. The month-by-month version, with strong and weak Day Master shares, is in the 2027 baby elements table.

## Does the Goat zodiac change which characters to choose?

Not in this engine, which picks characters from the baby's own chart and has no zodiac-animal rule. A popular practice favours grass or grain radicals for a Goat baby and avoids ox and tiger radicals, and this engine does not use it. The builder reads a Five Elements tag on each character, and for some characters that tag is inferred from the radical and shown with lower confidence beside the score.

Score a name for your own baby: free name builder →

## What does a worked example look like for 2027?

Two fictional Goat-year babies with the surname 王 show how one year gives different needs. The engine cast both for Singapore, and the names are the builder's own top three.

Fictional baby | Four Pillars (year, month, day, hour) | Day Master | Favourable list, lead first | Top three names for the surname 王 | 

Boy, 15 Jun 2027, 09:30 | 丁未 丙午 乙丑 庚辰 | Weak | Water (水), Wood (木) | 王福慧; 王源慧; 王溪慧 (all Water) | 

Girl, 20 Dec 2027, 09:30 | 丁未 壬子 癸酉 丙辰 | Strong | Wood (木), Fire (火), Earth (土) | 王嘉莹; 王嘉贤; 王琴朴 (all Wood) | 

The summer boy has a weak Day Master, so the engine lists Water first and Wood second, and his top names use Water characters. The winter girl has a strong Day Master, so it lists Wood, Fire and Earth, and her top names use Wood characters. All six names score 100.0, grade excellent, so they tie and the choice belongs to the family. The babies and the names are fictional.

## What should parents check before choosing a name?

Check the birth date and time to the minute, because the year, the month and the hour pillar can each change within a few hours. A birth within a day of a month change needs the exact solar-term moment, and a birth near a two-hour boundary can change the hour pillar and the useful god.

Then enter the birth in the baby name builder. Element fit is 37.5 of the 100 points, so stroke grids, sound and meaning still count, as how Chinese baby names are scored explains.

## FAQ

### What is the Chinese zodiac for a baby born in 2027?

A baby born from Start of Spring (09:45:59 on 4 February 2027) to the next one (15:30:53 on 4 February 2028) is a Fire Goat (丁未) baby. A baby born earlier in January 2027 is a Fire Horse (丙午) baby, because the BaZi year turns at Start of Spring, not on 1 January.

### Which element does a baby born in 2027 need?

It depends on the chart, but Water (水) is needed most often: it is favourable in 62.6% of 17,530 charts cast for the Goat year. Summer babies almost always need Water, winter babies almost always need Fire, and spring and autumn babies vary.

### Does the Goat zodiac decide the name characters?

No. The name builder picks characters whose element suits the baby's own chart, and it has no zodiac-animal rule. The score looks at element fit, stroke grids, sound and meaning, and the zodiac animal is not an input to any of them.

### Is a baby born on 4 February 2027 a Horse or a Goat baby?

It depends on the moment: Start of Spring falls at 09:45:59 on the Singapore clock, and the builder switches at exactly that moment. A baby born at 05:00 is a Horse baby, one born at 11:00 a Goat baby, so check the registered time.

### Is the exact birth time needed to name a 2027 baby?

Yes, to the minute if possible. The date sets the year and month pillars, and the time sets the hour pillar, which changes every two hours in true solar time. A birth near a boundary can change the pillars and the useful god.

## Sources and method

- Year boundary and solar-term moments: the sxtwl calendar library inside the engine (`engine/calendar.py`), read as Singapore clock time (UTC+8).

- Chart and useful god: `engine/bazi.py` and `engine/yongshen.py`: support and restrain, climate adjustment (the 窮通寶鑑 table in `engine/tiaohou.py`), and illness and remedy (病藥) checked beside them, as the engine cites 《滴天髓》〈中和〉.

- Element shares: 17,530 births, one for every clock hour of true solar time from Start of Spring 2027 to Start of Spring 2028, both sexes, fixed seed, engine as of 15 October 2026 (method).

- Name suggestions and scores: `engine/naming.py`. The popular zodiac practice mentioned above is not sourced here.

# Symbolic Stars (神煞) in BaZi: What They Add

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/shensha-symbolic-stars
Updated: 2026-10-09

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-09
Symbolic stars are fixed lookup tables that attach a named star to a chart when particular stem and branch combinations occur. They are annotation on top of the structural reading. The element balance, ten gods and palaces carry the weight, and the stars add texture.

## How do the lookup tables attach a star?

Each star has a key and a table. The key is a stem, a branch or an element taken from the chart. The table returns one or more branches. If any pillar's branch matches, the star is attached to that pillar. The pillar then decides the life area and era the star colours, as the four palaces describe.

The sample is 王大明, a fictional man born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore. His pillars are 戊辰 (Earth Dragon) 乙卯 (Wood Rabbit) 己巳 (Earth Snake) 戊辰 and his Day Master is 己 (yin Earth). The engine checks the stem-keyed nobles from both the day stem and the year stem. It checks the branch-keyed stars from both the year branch and the day branch.

Key facts

- A star is a pure lookup: a key from the chart goes into a fixed table, and a matching branch attaches the star to that pillar.
- For Day Master 己, the 文昌 (study star) branch is 酉 (Rooster, Metal), the 學堂 (study hall) branch is 寅 (Tiger, Wood), and the 天乙貴人 (nobleman star) branches are 子 (Rat, Water) and 申 (Monkey, Metal).
- The sample chart carries three stars: 太極貴人 (year and hour), 華蓋 (year and hour) and 劫煞 (day).
- The sample has no 天乙貴人, 文昌貴人 (study star), 學堂, 桃花 (romance star), 驛馬 (travel horse), 祿神 (salary star) or 空亡 (void).
- The sample's void branches are 戌 (Dog, Earth) and 亥 (Pig, Water), taken from the day pillar 己巳, and none of his branches falls there.
- In the engine's learning score, a 華蓋 adds +10 points of a 70-point result, so a star nudges the score and never decides it.

Lookup diagram showing how a Day Master or branch key is matched against a fixed table to attach a star to one pillar
Table 1: where each star is looked up

Star | Key | Table result for the sample | Meaning (engine wording) | 

天乙貴人 | day stem, year stem | 己: 子 or 申; 戊 (yang Earth): 丑 (Ox, Earth) or 未 (Goat, Earth) | helpful people appear at critical moments | 

太極貴人 | day stem, year stem | 己 and 戊: 辰 (Dragon, Earth), 戌, 丑, 未 | affinity for philosophy, metaphysics, deep research | 

文昌貴人 | day stem, year stem | 己: 酉; 戊: 申 | study, writing, examinations | 

學堂 | Day Master element | Earth: 寅 | natural learner, academic aptitude | 

祿神 | day stem | 己: 午 (Horse, Fire) | innate earning capacity | 

羊刃 (goat blade) | day stem | 己 has no entry | drive and decisiveness | 

天德 (heavenly virtue) 貴人 (helpful people) | month branch | 卯 (Rabbit, Wood): 申 | protective benevolence, eases crises | 

月德 (monthly virtue) 貴人 | month branch | 卯: 甲 (yang Wood) | quiet protection and goodwill | 

空亡 | day pillar's ten-day group | 己巳: 戌, 亥 | the tagged pillar's matters feel intangible until triggered | 

The engine's 學堂 table by element is Wood 亥, Fire 寅, Earth 寅, Metal 巳 (Snake, Fire) and Water 申. Earth borrows Fire's position, which is the table's convention (method note).

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## Which stars are worth knowing?

Five stars come from the year or day branch group. Table 2 gives the fixed result for each of the four groups.

Table 2: branch-group stars

Group | 桃花 | 驛馬 | 華蓋 | 將星 (general star) | 劫煞 | 

申·子·辰 | 酉 | 寅 | 辰 | 子 | 巳 | 

寅·午·戌 | 卯 | 申 | 戌 | 午 | 亥 | 

巳·酉·丑 | 午 | 亥 | 丑 | 酉 | 寅 | 

亥·卯·未 | 子 | 巳 | 未 | 卯 | 申 | 

The sample's year branch 辰 belongs to the 申·子·辰 group. That group's 華蓋 is 辰, which sits in his year and hour pillars. Its 劫煞 is 巳, which is his day branch. Its 桃花 is 酉, 驛馬 is 寅 and 將星 is 子, and none of those appears in his four branches. His day branch 巳 belongs to the 巳·酉·丑 group, whose stars are 午, 亥, 丑, 酉 and 寅. None of them appears either.

In plain terms, the engine gives these readings:

- 天乙貴人 Nobleman. The most valued star. Help arrives through people at critical moments.

- 文昌貴人 Scholar star. Study, writing and examinations. Its direction gives the study corner.

- 華蓋 Canopy. Solitary depth, spirituality and the arts. The engine adds that it thrives on niche study.

- 將星 General star. Leadership and command presence.

- 桃花 Peach Blossom. Charm, attraction and social magnetism, mostly read through the years that trigger it.

- 劫煞 Robbery Sha. Guard resources and avoid overexposure to risk. It is a note, not a threat.

- 空亡 Void. The tagged pillar's matters feel intangible until triggered.

## What does the sample chart show?

The engine finds three stars. 太極貴人 sits in the year and hour pillars, which reads as an affinity for philosophy, metaphysics and deep research. 華蓋 sits in the same two pillars, which reads as solitary depth and spirituality. 劫煞 sits in the day pillar, which reads as guard resources.

The absences matter as much as the hits. No 天乙貴人 is present. 己 needs 子 or 申 and 戊 needs 丑 or 未, but the chart's branches are 辰, 卯, 巳 and 辰. The engine does not invent a helper star to fill the gap. No 空亡 is present either, since 戌 and 亥 are missing from the chart.

The stars also feed the engine's domain scores. The learning structure scores 70 (prominent), built from resource (印) present at +10, 華蓋 at +10 and the rest from the structure. The score is assembled from auditable parts, and the stars are a minority of them. The engine labels these scores a modern synthesis, not a classical rule (method note).

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How much weight should the stars get?

Less than the structure, every time. A Nobleman does not rescue a chart whose useful element is buried, and a Void does not sink one whose structure is sound. The honest use of symbolic stars is descriptive precision. They give a name to textures people recognise in themselves, such as the student who tests as brilliant but studies alone.

When a star and the structure agree, say it once with confidence. When they disagree, the structure wins. That ordering is how the engine builds every reading it computes. The sample's structure is a weak Day Master with Fire (火) and Earth (土) as favourable elements, and the three stars only colour it.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

Stars depend on the year pillar, the day pillar and the month branch, so the local calendar rules matter.

- Year boundary. The year stem and year branch change at Start of Spring (立春), which falls on 2027-02-04 for the 2027 year. A birth in late January or early February may carry the previous year's stem. That gives a different set of nobles and a different branch group.

- Time zone. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A wrong offset can change the hour pillar, and the hour pillar is one of the four places a star can land.

- Month branch. 天德 and 月德 key off the month branch, which turns at the solar terms and not on the calendar month.

- Homes. The 文昌 star is the one with a direct use in an HDB flat or condominium unit. It tells you which corner of the unit suits a desk. See the study corner guide.

## FAQ

### What are symbolic stars in BaZi?

Symbolic stars are fixed lookup tables that attach a named star to a chart when particular stem and branch combinations occur. They are annotation on top of the structural reading. The element balance, ten gods and palaces carry the weight.

### How is a symbolic star attached to my chart?

Each star has a key and a table. The key is a stem, a branch or an element from the chart. The table returns one or more branches. If any pillar's branch matches, the star is attached to that pillar.

### Does a 天乙貴人 Nobleman star rescue a weak chart?

No. A Nobleman does not rescue a chart whose useful element is buried, and a Void does not sink one whose structure is sound. When a star and the structure disagree, the structure wins. Stars only give texture.

### What if my chart has no 桃花 or 天乙貴人 star?

The engine does not invent a star to fill the gap. The sample chart has no 天乙貴人 because its branches are 辰, 卯, 巳 and 辰. Absences matter as much as hits, and they do not mean anything is wrong.

### Why does my year of birth matter for stars in Singapore or Malaysia?

Stars depend on the year pillar, the day pillar and the month branch. The year stem and branch change at Start of Spring, not 1 January. A late January or early February birth may carry the previous year's stem. A wrong time zone offset can also change the hour pillar.

## Sources and method

- Star tables: the classical lookup tables for Tianyi (天乙), Taiji (太極), 文昌, 學堂, 祿神, 羊刃, 天德, 月德 and the branch-group stars, as coded in the engine.

- Checking rule: nobles checked from both the day stem and the year stem; branch-group stars checked from both the year and day branches (method note).

- Void branches: 空亡 taken from the day pillar's ten-day group.

- Meanings: the engine's own wording for each star (method note).

- Weighting: structure first, stars as annotation, which is the engine's ordering (method note).

- Stem and branch relations: 三命通會 (Ming-era BaZi classic), in the chapters the engine cites.

Find which stars your own chart carries in the free reading at /start, and see how their timing plays out in luck cycles and windows.

# Ten Gods (十神) Explained: Groups and Cycles

Source: https://bazifor.me/learn/ten-gods-guide
Updated: 2026-10-08

BaZi Basics

By BaziMaster 2026-09-19 Updated 2026-10-08
The Ten Gods are the ten relationships any stem can have to your Day Master. Each is a pair of one element role split by yin and yang polarity: peers, output, wealth, authority and resource. Every visible or hidden stem, and every luck pillar, falls into one of the ten.

## What are the ten gods, and how are they grouped?

They come in five pairs, one pair per elemental role. The engine names the groups peers (比劫), output (食傷), wealth (財), authority (官殺) and resource (印). The 正 god of a pair is the conventional, steady flavour; its partner is the intense, unconventional one, powerful when channelled and costly when not.

Which god a stem is depends on your Day Master. Table 1 is the full list for Day Master 己, with the group and the engine's meaning for each god.

Key facts

- There are 10 gods in 5 groups: peers, output, wealth, authority and resource.
- For Day Master 己, the stem 甲 (yang Wood) is Direct Officer (正官) and the stem 乙 (yin Wood) is Seven Killings (七殺).
- The sample chart's distribution is Rob Wealth (劫財) 48.1 %, Seven Killings 29.6 %, Direct Resource (正印) 11.1 %, Indirect Wealth (偏財) 7.4 % and Hurting Officer (傷官) 3.7 %.
- The sample's current luck pillar is 己未 (Earth Goat) for ages 37-47, with Friend (比肩) on both stem and branch.
- The luck sequence runs forward from the month pillar 乙卯 (Wood Rabbit) and starts at age 6.8, by the rule yang men and yin women count forward (陽男陰女順行) with luck-cycle start (起運) = distance to the solar-term boundary (節) divided by 3.
- The 2027 year pillar is 丁未 (Fire Goat) from Start of Spring (立春), 2027-02-04, and 丁 (yin Fire) is Indirect Resource (偏印) for a 己 Day Master.

Wheel of the ten gods in five paired groups, showing peers, output, wealth, authority and resource around the Day Master
Table 1: the ten gods for Day Master 己

Stem | God | Group | Engine meaning | 

甲 | Direct Officer | Authority | proper authority: rules, status, responsibility (spouse star in a woman's chart) | 

乙 | Seven Killings | Authority | raw pressure: ambition, decisiveness, discipline imposed from outside | 

丙 (yang Fire) | Direct Resource | Resource | nurturing support: study, protection, elders, credentials | 

丁 | Indirect Resource | Resource | unconventional learning: intuition, niche skills, solitary study | 

戊 (yang Earth) | Rob Wealth | Peers | rivals & boldness: shared resources, competition, risk appetite | 

己 | Friend | Peers | peers & self-reliance: siblings, equals, standing your ground | 

庚 (yang Metal) | Hurting Officer | Output | sharp output: brilliance, critique, rebellion against rules | 

辛 (yin Metal) | Eating God (食神) | Output | gentle output: enjoyment, nurture, easy creativity | 

壬 (yang Water) | Direct Wealth (正財) | Wealth | steady wealth: salary, prudence, savings (spouse star in a man's chart) | 

癸 (yin Water) | Indirect Wealth | Wealth | windfall wealth: opportunity, generosity, business flair | 

Wealth and authority carry a second meaning in the classics: wealth is the spouse star in a man's chart and authority is the spouse star in a woman's chart. The gods also stand for people (family roles, 六親): wealth for the father, resource for the mother and mentors, peers for siblings.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## What are the bright and shadow sides of each god?

Every god has a bright side and a shadow side. The shadow shows when the god is excessive or unsupported, so a prominent god is both your engine and your watch-list.

Table 2: bright and shadow sides

God | Bright side | Shadow side | 

Direct Resource | broad learning, kindness, quiet support | over-reliance, idealism, indecision | 

Indirect Resource | deep insight in niche fields, original self-taught skill | solitary, suspicious, keeps people at arm's length | 

Direct Officer | responsibility, order, stable social standing | conservatism, rule-bound pressure and anxiety | 

Seven Killings | leadership in adversity, execution, pioneering | impulsiveness; health and legal risks | 

Friend | confident, loyal, natural team player | stubborn over spoils, self-centred splits | 

Rob Wealth | strong social drive, dares to take risks | impulsive losses, easily talked into traps | 

Eating God | overflowing talent, easy-going, deep bond with children | comfort-seeking, weak follow-through, indulgence | 

Hurting Officer | innovation, eloquence, artistic force | rebellious, attracts resentment, marriage friction | 

Direct Wealth | diligence, steady income, loyalty | stingy, conservative, material over spirit | 

Indirect Wealth | keen money sense, generosity, seizes windfalls | extravagance, tangled romantic affairs | 

The classical "four benign" gods are Direct Officer, Direct Resource, Direct Wealth and Eating God. The "four fierce" are Seven Killings, Hurting Officer, Indirect Resource and Rob Wealth.

## How do you read a distribution chart?

A distribution chart weighs every visible and hidden stem and shows how the chart's energy divides among the ten. Three habits make it useful.

- Heavy bars are engine and watch-list. A god with a large share is real strength and real pressure at once.

- Empty bars are not doom. A missing god is a domain that does not run on autopilot, not a curse. No peers means self-drive must be deliberate, and no authority means structure has to be chosen.

- Percentages start the reading, structure finishes it. Whether the heavy god sits on a favourable element, whether it is rooted in a branch, and what the gods form together decide how the weight behaves.

## What does the sample chart show?

The sample person is 王大明, male, born 1988-03-15 at 09:30 in Singapore, with pillars 戊辰 (Earth Dragon) 乙卯 己巳 (Earth Snake) 戊辰 and Day Master 己. The engine's distribution is Rob Wealth 48.1 %, Seven Killings 29.6 %, Direct Resource 11.1 %, Indirect Wealth 7.4 % and Hurting Officer 3.7 %. The other five gods do not appear in the engine's list.

By group, peers carry 48.1 %, authority 29.6 %, resource 11.1 %, wealth 7.4 % and output 3.7 %. The engine's personality axes read from these shares:

- Creative and verbal output: quiet output, because output is 4 % (the engine calls 5 % or less quiet).

- Action: decisive and acts under pressure, because Seven Killings plus Rob Wealth is 78 %.

- Authority stance: no strong tendency, because authority is 30 % but all of it is Seven Killings and Direct Officer is 0 % (the engine reads working within structure only when Direct Officer is at least as large), with Hurting Officer at 4 %.

- Thinking style: no strong tendency, with resource at 11 % against wealth at 7 %.

- Frankness: direct, says it plainly, with peers at 48 %.

- Pace of life (settled or on the move): settled: few pulls to move. Basis: 驛馬 absent, 六沖 0 (on the move: both present; settled: neither).

- Social energy (private or sociable): private: recharges alone. Basis: 桃花 absent, 華蓋 present (sociable: 桃花 without 華蓋; private: 華蓋 without 桃花).

- Self-direction (collaborative or self-directed): no strong tendency. Basis: 日主強弱 score -0.97 (+1 or more self-directed, -1 or less collaborative).

These thresholds are the engine's own (method note). The chart's weak Day Master (身弱, score -0.97) is the context for reading the heavy Rob Wealth and Seven Killings shares.

See these rules applied to your own chart: free BaZi reading →

## How do the gods arrive with time?

The chart is the cast and the calendar is the schedule. Each ten-year luck pillar (luck cycles, 大運) carries a stem god and a branch god for your Day Master. The sample runs forward because the rule is yang man, yin woman forward, and it starts at age 6.8, counted as the distance to the next solar-term boundary divided by 3.

Table 3: the sample's luck pillars

Pillar | Ages | Stem god | Branch god | Keywords | 

丙辰 (Fire Dragon) | 7-17 | Direct Resource | Rob Wealth | learning & support | 

丁巳 (Fire Snake) | 17-27 | Indirect Resource | Direct Resource | intuition & niche skills | 

戊午 (Earth Horse) | 27-37 | Rob Wealth | Indirect Resource | competition & bold moves | 

己未 | 37-47 | Friend | Friend | self-drive & peers (current) | 

庚申 (Metal Monkey) | 47-57 | Hurting Officer | Hurting Officer | expression & disruption | 

辛酉 (Metal Rooster) | 57-67 | Eating God | Eating God | enjoyment & easy output | 

The current pillar 己未 puts Friend on both stem and branch, which the engine reads as self-drive and peers. The next, 庚申 from age 47, brings Hurting Officer twice, the god that is nearly absent in the natal chart.

## What changes for Singapore and Malaysia readers?

Annual years bring their own god. The 2027 year pillar is 丁未, and 丁 is Indirect Resource for a 己 Day Master, so the year carries unconventional learning and niche skills. The year turns at Start of Spring, 2027-02-04, so a Singapore or Malaysia birth in late January or early February may sit in the earlier year and change every god. Clock time matters too: Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it, and Malaysia has used UTC+8 since 1982-01-01. A shifted hour pillar changes the distribution.

## FAQ

### What are the Ten Gods in BaZi?

The Ten Gods are the ten relationships any stem can have to your Day Master. They come in five pairs: peers, output, wealth, authority and resource. Every visible or hidden stem, and every luck pillar, falls into one of the ten.

### Which Ten Gods are benign and which are fierce?

The classical four benign gods are Direct Officer, Direct Resource, Direct Wealth and Eating God. The four fierce gods are Seven Killings, Hurting Officer, Indirect Resource and Rob Wealth. Every god has a bright side and a shadow side, which shows when it is excessive or unsupported.

### Does a missing god in my chart mean bad luck?

No. Empty bars are not doom. A missing god is a domain that does not run on autopilot, not a curse. No peers means self-drive must be deliberate, and no authority means structure has to be chosen.

### How do I read a Ten Gods percentage chart?

A distribution chart weighs every visible and hidden stem. A heavy bar is both your engine and your watch-list. Percentages start the reading, and structure finishes it, such as whether the heavy god sits on a favourable element.

### Why can my birth details change my Ten Gods in Singapore or Malaysia?

The year turns at Start of Spring, so a late January or early February birth may sit in the earlier year and change every god. Singapore ran on UTC+7:30 before 1982-01-01 and UTC+8 after it. A shifted hour pillar changes the distribution.

## Sources and method

- Ten gods and their groups: the 子平 (classical BaZi school) convention of relating each stem to the Day Master by element and polarity, as listed in Table 1; the group names are the engine's.

- Meanings: the engine's own wording for each god (method note).

- Bright and shadow sides: the bazifor.me guide text (method note).

- Distribution and personality axes: the engine's weighted percentages and thresholds (method note).

- Luck pillars: yang men and yin women count forward, yin men and yang women count backward (陰男陽女逆行), with luck-cycle start = days to the solar-term boundary (距節日數)/3.
